card.name: Passing from mother to baby
card.fires_on: Words about something passing or being transferred, such as transferred, passes, cross, share, mostly where a mother's drug or antibody reaches a fetus or breast milk. Also fires on a few odd spots like the digit 1 in numbers.

modes.label: Transfer across placenta or milk
modes.description: Verbs or linking words about a substance moving from mother to fetus or infant.
modes.example: Autoantibodies may be<< transferred>> from the mother to the fetus during pregnancy

modes.label: Spreading or sharing
modes.description: Verbs for passing infection or files between people or machines.
modes.example: With shared folders, you can easily<< share>> files among virtual machines and the host computer

modes.label: Stray number or name parts
modes.description: Occasional hits on a digit or a piece of a drug name in pregnancy or nursing text.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning transfer or communicate, such as transfer and transmit.
card.plain: It lights up when text is about something being passed along, especially from mother to baby.
